methodology.consensus: Arithmetic mean of three independent direction and reversal-risk scores.
methodology.disparity: 0-100 composite dispersion from normalized pairwise gaps in direction scores and reversal-risk scores; lower is tighter agreement.
methodology.learned_lessons_review: Existing timing, one-decisive-KPI, priced-in-growth, low-bar reversal-risk and disagreement controls applied; no new method change.
